title.zh: 卷二十七 本紀第二十七: 天祚皇帝一
title.raw: 卷二十七 本紀第二十七: 天祚皇帝一 Volume 27 Annals 27: Emperor Tianzuo 1

sentences.zh: 壽隆七年[1]正月甲戌，道宗崩，奉遺詔即皇帝位於柩前。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Shoulong [1], first month, on jiaxu day, Daozong died; by testamentary edict he assumed the imperial dignity before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Shoulong [1], on jiaxu day of the first month Daozong died; by testamentary edict Tianzuo assumed the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 群臣上尊號曰天祚皇帝。

translations.literal: The hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Tianzuo.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred officials offered the honorific title Emperor Tianzuo.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰朔，改元乾統，大赦。

translations.literal: Second month, on renchen new moon, the era name was changed to Qiantong and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the second month the era name was changed to Qiantong and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 詔為耶律乙辛所誣陷者，復其官爵，籍沒者出之，流放者還之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that those framed by Yelü Yixin should have office and rank restored; those whose property had been confiscated should have it returned; those exiled should be brought back.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered restoration of office and rank for those framed by Yelü Yixin, return of confiscated property, and recall of the exiled.

sentences.zh: 乙未，遣使告哀于宋及西夏、高麗。

translations.literal: On yiwei day envoys were dispatched to announce mourning to Song and to Western Xia and Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day envoys were sent to announce mourning to Song, Western Xia, and Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以北府宰相蕭兀納為遼興軍節度使，加守太傅。

translations.literal: On yisi day Northern Court chancellor Xiao Wuna was made military commissioner of Liaoxing Army and promoted Defender of the State grand mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Northern Court chancellor Xiao Wuna was made military commissioner of Liaoxing Army and promoted Defender of the State grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 三月丁卯，詔有司以張孝傑家屬分賜群臣。

translations.literal: Third month, on dingmao day, an edict ordered the relevant offices to distribute Zhang Xiaojie's family members among the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the third month an edict ordered the relevant offices to distribute Zhang Xiaojie's family members among the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，召僧法頤放戒於內庭。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the monk Fayi was summoned to grant precepts in the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the monk Fayi was summoned to grant precepts in the inner court.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，旱。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, drought.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, there was drought.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅朔，如慶州。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengyin new moon, went to Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon of the sixth month the court went to Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲午，宋遣王潛等來弔祭。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Song dispatched Wang Qian and others to offer mourning sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Song sent Wang Qian and others to offer mourning sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 丙申，高麗、夏國各遣使慰奠。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Goryeo and Xia State each dispatched envoys to offer condolences.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Goryeo and Xia State each sent envoys to offer condolences.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以南府宰相斡特剌兼南院樞密使。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Southern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Southern Court chancellor Wotela was also made Southern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚子，追懿德皇后為宣懿皇后。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Virtuous Consort was posthumously titled Empress Xuanyi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Virtuous Consort was posthumously titled Empress Xuanyi.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以宋魏國王和魯斡為天下兵馬大元帥。

translations.literal: On renyin day Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made supreme commander of all armies and horses under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made supreme commander of all armies and horses under heaven.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以北平郡王淳進封鄭王。

translations.literal: On yisi day Prince of Beiping Commandery Chun was advanced to Prince of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Prince of Beiping Commandery Chun was advanced to Prince of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 丁未，北院樞密使耶律阿思加於越。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Asi was promoted yuyue.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Asi was promoted yuyue.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，葬仁聖大孝文皇帝、宣懿皇后于慶陵。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi were buried at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi were buried at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸亥，阻卜、鐵驪來貢。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guihai day Zubu and Iron Li came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the seventh autumn month Zubu and Iron Li came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月甲寅，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiayin day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day of the eighth month the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，謁懷陵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renshen day paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the ninth month the court paid respects at Huai Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: On yihai day halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，謁乾陵。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renchen day paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the tenth winter month the court paid respects at Qian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上皇考昭懷太子曰大孝順聖皇帝，廟號順宗，皇妣曰貞順皇后。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the late imperial father, Heir Apparent Zhaohuai, was titled Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor with temple name Shunzong; the late imperial mother was titled Empress Zhenshun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the late imperial father, Heir Apparent Zhaohuai, was titled Great Filial Shun-Sage Emperor with temple name Shunzong; the late imperial mother was titled Empress Zhenshun.

sentences.zh: 初，以楊割為生女直部節度使，其俗呼為太師。

translations.literal: Initially Yangge was made military commissioner of the Raw Jurchen Division; their custom called him Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Yangge was made military commissioner of the Raw Jurchen Division; their custom called him Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 是歲楊割死，傳于兄之子烏雅束，束死，其弟阿骨打襲。

translations.literal: That year Yangge died and the post passed to his elder brother's son Wugusun; when Wugusun died, his younger brother Aguda succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yangge died and the post passed to his elder brother's son Wugusun; when Wugusun died, his younger brother Aguda succeeded.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，如鴨子河。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, went to Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 二月辛卯，如春州。

translations.literal: Second month, on xinmao day went to Chun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day of the second month the court went to Chun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月，大寒，冰復合。

translations.literal: Third month, great cold; ice formed again.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month there was great cold and the ice formed again.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，詔誅乙辛黨，徙其子孫于邊；

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinhai day, an edict ordered execution of Yixin's faction and relocation of their sons and grandsons to the border;
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the fourth summer month an edict ordered execution of Yixin's faction and relocation of their sons and grandsons to the border;

sentences.zh: 發乙辛、得里特之墓，剖棺，戮屍；

translations.literal: Yixin's and Delite's tombs were opened, coffins split, and corpses dismembered;
translations.idiomatic: Yixin's and Delite's tombs were opened, coffins split, and corpses dismembered;

sentences.zh: 以其家屬分賜被殺之家。

translations.literal: their families were distributed to the households of those who had been killed.
translations.idiomatic: their families were distributed to the households of those who had been killed.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，斡特剌獻耶睹刮等部捷。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on yichou day Wotela presented the victory of the Yeduoge and other divisions.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day of the fifth month Wotela presented the victory of the Yeduoge and other divisions.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，以雨罷獵，駐蹕散水原。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on renchen day, because of rain the hunt was abandoned and the court halted at Sanshui Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the sixth month, because of rain the hunt was abandoned and the court halted at Sanshui Plain.

sentences.zh: 丙午，夏國王李乾順復遣使請尚公主。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Xia King Li Qianshun again dispatched envoys requesting marriage to a princess.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Xia King Li Qianshun again sent envoys requesting marriage to a princess.

sentences.zh: 丁未，南院大王陳家奴致仕。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Southern Court great king Chenjianu retired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Southern Court great king Chenjianu retired.

sentences.zh: 壬子，李乾順為宋所攻，遣李造福、田若水求援。

translations.literal: On renzi day Li Qianshun, attacked by Song, dispatched Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Li Qianshun, attacked by Song, dispatched Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚申，策賢良。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on gengshen day, examination of worthy talent.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day of the intercalary month worthy talent was examined.

sentences.zh: 壬申，降惠妃為庶人。

translations.literal: On renshen day Favored Consort was demoted to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Favored Consort was demoted to commoner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，獵黑嶺，以霖雨，給獵人馬。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, hunted at Black Ridge; because of heavy rain, horses were given to the hunters.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Black Ridge; because of heavy rain horses were given to the hunters.

sentences.zh: 阻卜來侵，斡特剌等戰敗之。

translations.literal: Zubu came to invade; Wotela and others defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When Zubu came to invade, Wotela and others defeated them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，蕭海里叛，劫乾州武庫器甲。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yimao day Xiao Haili rebelled and plundered the armory of Qian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the tenth winter month Xiao Haili rebelled and plundered the armory of Qian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 命北面林牙郝家奴捕之，蕭海里亡入陪術水阿典部。

translations.literal: Northern Court linya Hao Jianu was ordered to capture him; Xiao Haili fled into the Adian division of the Peishu River.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Court linya Hao Jianu was ordered to capture him; Xiao Haili fled into the Adian division of the Peishu River.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以南府宰相耶律斡特剌為北院樞密使，三知政事牛溫舒知南院樞密使事。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Wotela was made Northern Court privy commissioner; third associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Wotela was made Northern Court privy commissioner; third associate administrator of affairs Niu Wenshu administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，郝家奴以不獲蕭海里，免官。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yiwei day Hao Jianu, for failing to capture Xiao Haili, was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day of the eleventh month Hao Jianu, for failing to capture Xiao Haili, was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以上京留守耶律慎思為北院樞密副使。

translations.literal: On renyin day Supreme Capital intendant Yelü Shensi was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Supreme Capital intendant Yelü Shensi was made associate Northern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 有司請以帝生日為天興節。

translations.literal: The relevant offices requested that the emperor's birthday be made the Tianxing Festival.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices requested that the emperor's birthday be made the Tianxing Festival.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月辛巳朔，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on xinsi new moon, went to Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the xinsi new moon of the first spring month the court went to Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 女直函蕭海里首，遣使來獻。

translations.literal: Jurchen sent Xiao Haili's head in a box and dispatched envoys to present it.
translations.idiomatic: Jurchen sent Xiao Haili's head in a box and dispatched envoys to present it.

sentences.zh: 戊申，如春州。

translations.literal: On wushen day went to Chun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the court went to Chun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，以武清縣大水，弛其陂澤之禁。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengwu day, because of great flood at Wuqing County, prohibitions on ponds and marshes were relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day of the second month, because of great flood at Wuqing County, prohibitions on ponds and marshes were relaxed.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊子，以獵人多亡，嚴立科禁。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, on wuzi day, because many hunters had fled, strict statutes were established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the fifth summer month, because many hunters had fled, strict statutes were established.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，清暑赤勒嶺。

translations.literal: On yisi day took summer ease at Chile Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the court took summer ease at Chile Ridge.

sentences.zh: 丙午，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: On bingwu day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，夏國王李乾順復遣使請尚公主。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinyou day Xia King Li Qianshun again dispatched envoys requesting marriage to a princess.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day of the sixth month Xia King Li Qianshun again sent envoys requesting marriage to a princess.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，中京雨雹，傷稼。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, at Central Capital hail damaged the crops.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month hail at Central Capital damaged the crops.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，如中京。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiachen day went to Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day of the tenth winter month the court went to Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 己未，吐蕃遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚申，夏國復遣使求援。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Xia State again dispatched envoys seeking aid.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Xia State again sent envoys seeking aid.

sentences.zh: 己巳，有事於觀德殿。

translations.literal: On jisi day rites were performed at Guande Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day rites were performed at Guande Hall.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，文武百官加上尊號曰惠文智武聖孝天祚皇帝，大赦，以宋魏國王和魯斡為皇太叔，梁王撻魯進封燕國王，鄭王淳為東京留守，進封越國王，百官各進一階。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen day civil and military officials added the honorific title Benevolent, Cultured, Wise, Martial, Sagely, Filial Emperor Tianzuo; general amnesty; Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made Imperial Grand Uncle; Prince of Liang Taluo was advanced to Prince of Yan; Prince of Zheng Chun was made Eastern Capital intendant and advanced to Prince of Yue; all officials were promoted one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day of the eleventh month civil and military officials added the honorific title Benevolent, Cultured, Wise, Martial, Sagely, Filial Emperor Tianzuo; a general amnesty was proclaimed; Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made Imperial Grand Uncle; Prince of Liang Taluo was advanced to Prince of Yan; Prince of Zheng Chun was made Eastern Capital intendant and advanced to Prince of Yue; all officials were promoted one grade.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以惕隱耶律何魯掃古為南院大王。

translations.literal: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Heluosaogu was made Southern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day tiyin Yelü Heluosaogu was made Southern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以受尊號，告廟。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, because of receiving the honorific title, announcement was made at the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, because of receiving the honorific title, announcement was made at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，謁太祖廟，追尊太祖之高祖曰昭烈皇帝，廟號肅祖，妣曰昭烈皇后；

translations.literal: On yisi day paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.

sentences.zh: 曾祖曰莊敬皇帝，廟號懿祖，妣曰莊敬皇后。

translations.literal: Great-grandfather was titled Emperor Zhuangjing with temple name Yizu; his consort was titled Empress Zhuangjing.
translations.idiomatic: The great-grandfather was titled Emperor Zhuangjing with temple name Yizu; his consort was titled Empress Zhuangjing.

sentences.zh: 召監修國史耶律儼纂太祖諸帝實錄。

translations.literal: Supervisor of compilation of the national history Yelü Yan was summoned to compile Veritable Records of the various emperors from Taizu onward.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor of compilation of the national history Yelü Yan was summoned to compile Veritable Records of the various emperors from Taizu onward.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，如藕絲澱。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on wushen day went to Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day of the twelfth month the court went to Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 是年，放進士馬恭回等百三人。

translations.literal: That year advanced scholars Ma Gonghui and one hundred three others were released.
translations.idiomatic: That year advanced scholars Ma Gonghui and one hundred three others were released.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，鼻骨德遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingchou day the Nose-bone tribe dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day of the second month the Nose-bone tribe sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏六月甲辰，駐蹕旺國崖。

translations.literal: Summer, sixth month, on jiachen day halted at Wangguo Cliff.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day of the sixth summer month the court halted at Wangguo Cliff.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，夏國遣李造福、田若水求援。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Xia State dispatched Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Xia State sent Li Zaofu and Tian Ruoshui to seek aid.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，吐蕃遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On guihai day Tibet dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Tibet sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，南京蝗。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, locusts at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month there were locusts at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，獵南山。

translations.literal: On gengchen day hunted at Southern Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the court hunted at Southern Mountain.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以西北路招討使蕭得里底、北院樞密副使耶律慎思並知北院樞密使事。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Delidi and associate Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Shensi both administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Delidi and associate Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Shensi both administered Northern Court privy commissioner affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以同知南院樞密使事蕭敵里為西北路招討使。

translations.literal: On xinmao day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Dili was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Dili was made Northwest Route pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉，鳳凰見於陰。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiyou day a phoenix appeared at Yin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day of the tenth winter month a phoenix appeared at Yin.

sentences.zh: 己未，幸南京。

translations.literal: On jiwei day went to Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the court went to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，禦迎月樓，賜貧民錢。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yihai day at Welcome Moon Tower money was bestowed on poor people.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day of the eleventh month at Welcome Moon Tower money was bestowed on poor people.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，以張琳為南府宰相。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on xinchou day Zhang Lin was made Southern Court chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day of the twelfth month Zhang Lin was made Southern Court chancellor.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙亥，夏國遣李造福等來求援，且乞伐宋。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on yihai day Xia State dispatched Li Zaofu and others to seek aid and also requested an attack on Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on yihai day of the first spring month Xia State sent Li Zaofu and others to seek aid and also requested an attack on Song.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以遼興軍節度使蕭常哥為北府宰相。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Changge was made Northern Court chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Xiao Changge was made Northern Court chancellor.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣樞密直學士高端禮等諷宋罷伐夏兵。

translations.literal: On dingyou day privy council academician Gao Duanli and others were dispatched to admonish Song to cease attacking Xia troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day privy council academician Gao Duanli and others were sent to admonish Song to cease attacking Xia troops.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，微行，視民疾苦。

translations.literal: Second month, on guimao day made a private tour to observe the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 初，阿骨打混同江宴歸，疑上知其異志，遂稱兵，先並旁近部族。

translations.literal: Initially, when Aguda returned from the Huntong River banquet he suspected the emperor knew his other intent and thereupon raised troops, first annexing nearby divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Initially, when Aguda returned from the Huntong River banquet he suspected the emperor knew his other intent and thereupon raised troops, first annexing nearby divisions.

sentences.zh: 女直趙三、阿鶻產拒之，阿骨打虜其家屬。

translations.literal: Jurchen Zhao San and Ahechan resisted; Aguda captured their families.
translations.idiomatic: Jurchen Zhao San and Ahechan resisted; Aguda captured their families.

sentences.zh: 二人走訴咸州，詳穩司送北樞密院。

translations.literal: The two men fled to complain at Xian Prefecture; the detailed-stable office sent them to the Northern Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: The two men fled to complain at Xian Prefecture; the detailed-stable office sent them to the Northern Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 樞密使蕭奉先作常事以聞上，仍送咸州詰責，欲使自新。

translations.literal: Privy Commissioner Xiao Fengxian reported it as an ordinary matter to the emperor and still sent them back to Xian Prefecture to be questioned and rebuked, intending that they reform themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Commissioner Xiao Fengxian reported it as an ordinary matter to the emperor and still sent them back to Xian Prefecture to be questioned and rebuked, intending that they reform themselves.

sentences.zh: 後數召，阿骨打竟稱疾不至。

translations.literal: After several summonses Aguda in the end claimed illness and did not come.
translations.idiomatic: After several summonses Aguda in the end claimed illness and did not come.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，高麗三韓國公王之母死，來告，即遣使致祭，起復。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on xinhai day the mother of Goryeo Duke of Three Han States Wang died; envoys came to announce it; envoys were immediately dispatched to offer sacrifice and grant mourning leave.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the tenth winter month the mother of Goryeo Duke of Three Han States Wang died; envoys came to announce it; envoys were immediately sent to offer sacrifice and grant mourning leave.

sentences.zh: 是月，駐蹕奉聖州。

translations.literal: That month halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，幸南京。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yimao day went to Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the eleventh month the court went to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，謁太祖廟。

translations.literal: On dingmao day paid respects at Taizu's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple.

sentences.zh: 是年，放進士韓等七十七人。

translations.literal: That year advanced scholars Han and seventy-seven others were released.
translations.idiomatic: That year advanced scholars Han and seventy-seven others were released.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙寅，賜南京貧民錢。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on bingyin day money was bestowed on poor people of Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on bingyin day of the first spring month money was bestowed on poor people of Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，如大魚濼。

translations.literal: On dingmao day went to Great Fish Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the court went to Great Fish Marsh.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，禁僧尼破戒。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day monks and nuns were forbidden to break precepts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day monks and nuns were forbidden to break precepts.

sentences.zh: 丙子，獵狗牙山，大寒，獵人多死。

translations.literal: On bingzi day hunted at Dog Tooth Mountain; great cold; many hunters died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the court hunted at Dog Tooth Mountain; there was great cold and many hunters died.

sentences.zh: 三月，籍諸道戶，徙大牢古山圍場地居民于別土。

translations.literal: Third month, households of all circuits were registered; residents of the Dalao Hunting Ground were moved to other lands.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month households of all circuits were registered; residents of the Dalao Hunting Ground were moved to other lands.

sentences.zh: 阿骨打一日率五百騎突至咸州，吏民大驚。

translations.literal: One day Aguda led five hundred horsemen in a sudden dash to Xian Prefecture; officials and people were greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: One day Aguda led five hundred horsemen in a sudden dash to Xian Prefecture; officials and people were greatly alarmed.

sentences.zh: 翌日，赴詳穩司，與趙三等面折庭下。

translations.literal: The next day he went to the detailed-stable office and faced Zhao San and the others in debate beneath the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he went to the detailed-stable office and faced Zhao San and the others in debate beneath the hall.

sentences.zh: 阿骨打不屈，送所司問狀。

translations.literal: Aguda would not yield and was sent to the relevant office for questioning.
translations.idiomatic: Aguda would not yield and was sent to the relevant office for questioning.

sentences.zh: 一夕遁去。

translations.literal: In one night he fled.
translations.idiomatic: In one night he fled.

sentences.zh: 遣人訴於上，謂詳穩司欲見殺，故不敢留。

translations.literal: He sent men to complain to the emperor, saying the detailed-stable office wished to kill him, so he dared not stay.
translations.idiomatic: He sent men to complain to the emperor, saying the detailed-stable office wished to kill him, so he dared not stay.

sentences.zh: 自是召不復至。

translations.literal: From then on when summoned he never came again.
translations.idiomatic: From then on when summoned he never came again.

sentences.zh: 夏閏四月，李弘以左道聚眾為亂，支解，分示五京。

translations.literal: Summer, intercalary fourth month, Li Hong gathered a crowd by heterodox ways and made disorder; he was dismembered and the parts displayed at the Five Capitals.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth summer month Li Hong gathered a crowd by heterodox ways and made disorder; he was dismembered and the parts displayed at the Five Capitals.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，斡朗改國遣使來貢良犬。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on yimao day Wolanggai State dispatched envoys presenting fine dogs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the sixth month Wolanggai State sent envoys presenting fine dogs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，夏國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Xia State dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，幸秋山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, went to Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court went to Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 九月，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: Ninth month, halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，以三司使虞融知南院樞密使事，西南面招討使蕭樂古為南府宰相。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day Three Departments commissioner Yu Rong administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs; Southwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Yegu was made Southern Court chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day of the eleventh month Three Departments commissioner Yu Rong administered Southern Court privy commissioner affairs; Southwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Yegu was made Southern Court chancellor.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，高麗遣使來謝致祭。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on gengxu day Goryeo dispatched envoys to give thanks for the sacrificial mission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day of the twelfth month Goryeo sent envoys to give thanks for the sacrificial mission.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，回鶻遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On guichou day Uighurs dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Uighurs sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以樞密直學士馬人望三知政事。

translations.literal: On jiayin day privy council academician Ma Renwang was third associate administrator of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day privy council academician Ma Renwang was made third associate administrator of affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，知樞密院事耶律儼薨。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Administrator of Privy Council Affairs Yelü Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Administrator of Privy Council Affairs Yelü Yan died.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，高麗遣使來謝起復。

translations.literal: On guihai day Goryeo dispatched envoys to give thanks for mourning leave.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Goryeo sent envoys to give thanks for mourning leave.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月，如春州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, went to Chun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the first spring month the court went to Chun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初，女直起兵，以紇石烈部人阿疏不從，遣其部撒改討之。

translations.literal: Initially when Jurchen raised troops, Ashu of the Hesilie division did not follow; his division was sent Sagai to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Initially when Jurchen raised troops, Ashu of the Hesilie division did not follow; his division was sent Sagai to attack him.

sentences.zh: 阿疏弟狄故保來告，詔諭使勿討，不聽，阿疏來奔。

translations.literal: Ashu's younger brother Dibao came to report; an edict admonished that he not be attacked; they did not listen; Ashu came to flee.
translations.idiomatic: Ashu's younger brother Dibao came to report; an edict admonished that he not be attacked; they did not listen; Ashu came to flee.

sentences.zh: 至是女直遣使來索，不發。

translations.literal: By then Jurchen dispatched envoys to demand him back; he was not handed over.
translations.idiomatic: By then Jurchen sent envoys to demand him back; he was not handed over.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，清暑散水原。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth summer month the court took summer ease at Sanshui Plain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，女直復遣使取阿疏，不發，乃遣侍御阿息保問境上多建城堡之故。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, Jurchen again dispatched envoys to take Ashu; he was not handed over; Attendant-in-Waiting Axi Bao was then dispatched to ask the reason for many castles built on the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month Jurchen again sent envoys to take Ashu; he was not handed over; Attendant-in-Waiting Axi Bao was then sent to ask the reason for many castles built on the border.

sentences.zh: 女直以慢語答曰：「若還阿疏，朝貢如故；

translations.literal: Jurchen answered in insolent words: "If Ashu is returned, tribute as before;
translations.idiomatic: Jurchen answered in insolent words, "If Ashu is returned, tribute as before;

sentences.zh: 不然，城未能已。

translations.literal: otherwise the building of castles cannot cease."
translations.idiomatic: otherwise the building of castles cannot cease."

sentences.zh: 」遂發渾河北諸軍，益東北路統軍司。

translations.literal: Thereupon armies north of the Hun River were mobilized and the Northeast Route supreme command office was strengthened.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon armies north of the Hun River were mobilized and the Northeast Route supreme command office was strengthened.

sentences.zh: 阿骨打乃與弟粘罕、胡舍等謀，」一○：以銀術割、移烈、婁室、母等為帥，集女直諸部兵，擒遼障鷹官。

translations.literal: Aguda then plotted with his younger brothers Nianhan, Hushe, and others — [10]: making Yinjishuge, Yilie, Loushi, Mu, and others commanders, he gathered Jurchen divisions and captured Liao border hawk officials.
translations.idiomatic: Aguda then plotted with his younger brothers Nianhan, Hushe, and others — [10]: making Yinjishuge, Yilie, Loushi, Mu, and others commanders, he gathered Jurchen divisions and captured Liao border hawk officials.

sentences.zh: 及攻甯江州，東北路統軍司以聞。

translations.literal: When they attacked Ningzhou, the Northeast Route supreme command office reported it.
translations.idiomatic: When they attacked Ningzhou, the Northeast Route supreme command office reported it.

sentences.zh: 時上在慶州射鹿，聞之略不介意，遣海州刺史高仙壽統渤海軍應援。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor was shooting deer at Qing Prefecture; on hearing it he was little concerned and dispatched Haizhou prefect Gao Xianshou to command Bohai troops in relief.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the emperor was shooting deer at Qing Prefecture; on hearing it he was little concerned and dispatched Haizhou prefect Gao Xianshou to command Bohai troops in relief.

sentences.zh: 蕭撻不也遇女直，戰于甯江東，敗績。

translations.literal: Xiao Tabuye encountered Jurchen and fought east of Ningzhou; he was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Tabuye encountered Jurchen and fought east of Ningzhou; he was defeated.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅朔，」一一：以守司空蕭嗣先為東北路都統，靜江軍節度使蕭撻不也為副，發契丹奚軍三千人，中京禁兵及土豪二千人，別選諸路武勇二千餘人，以虞候崔公義為都押官，控鶴指揮邢穎為副，引軍屯出河店。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renyin new moon — [11]: Defender of the State Xiao Sixian was made northeast route commander-in-chief; Jingjiang Army military commissioner Xiao Tabuye was deputy; three thousand Khitan and Xi troops, Central Capital forbidden troops and local strongmen two thousand, and more than two thousand martial men selected from all routes — with scout-commander Cui Gongyi as chief escort officer and Crane-Control commander Xing Ying as deputy — led the army to encamp at Chuhe Store.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the tenth winter month — [11]: Defender of the State Xiao Sixian was made northeast route commander-in-chief; Jingjiang Army military commissioner Xiao Tabuye was deputy; three thousand Khitan and Xi troops, Central Capital forbidden troops and local strongmen two thousand, and more than two thousand martial men selected from all routes — with scout-commander Cui Gongyi as chief escort officer and Crane-Control commander Xing Ying as deputy — led the army to encamp at Chuhe Store.

sentences.zh: 兩軍對壘，女直軍潛渡混同江，掩擊遼眾。

translations.literal: The two armies faced each other; Jurchen troops secretly crossed Huntong River and struck the Liao force by surprise.
translations.idiomatic: The two armies faced each other; Jurchen troops secretly crossed Huntong River and struck the Liao force by surprise.

sentences.zh: 蕭嗣先軍潰，崔公義、邢穎、耶律佛留、蕭葛十等死之，其獲免者十有七人。

translations.literal: Xiao Sixian's army collapsed; Cui Gongyi, Xing Ying, Yelü Foliu, Xiao Geshi, and others died; of those who escaped barely seventeen men.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Sixian's army collapsed; Cui Gongyi, Xing Ying, Yelü Foliu, Xiao Geshi, and others died; of those who escaped barely seventeen men.

sentences.zh: 蕭奉先懼其弟嗣先獲罪，輒奏東征潰軍所至劫掠，若不肆赦，恐聚為患。

translations.literal: Xiao Fengxian feared his younger brother Sixian would be punished and memorialized that the eastern expedition's routed troops everywhere plundered; unless a sweeping pardon were granted they might gather into trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Fengxian feared his younger brother Sixian would be punished and memorialized that the eastern expedition's routed troops everywhere plundered; unless a sweeping pardon were granted they might gather into trouble.

sentences.zh: 上從之，嗣先但免官而已。

translations.literal: The emperor followed this; Sixian was only dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed this; Sixian was only dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 諸軍相謂曰：「戰則有死而無功，退則有生而無罪。

translations.literal: The armies said to one another: "In battle there is death without merit; in retreat there is life without guilt."
translations.idiomatic: The armies said to one another, "In battle there is death without merit; in retreat there is life without guilt."

sentences.zh: 」故士無鬥志，望風奔潰。

translations.literal: Therefore the soldiers had no fighting will and fled at sight of the wind.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the soldiers had no fighting will and fled at sight of the wind.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，都統蕭敵里等營於斡鄰濼東，又為女直所襲，士卒死者甚眾。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renchen day Commander-in-Chief Xiao Dili and others encamped east of Qinlin Marsh and were again struck by Jurchen; very many soldiers died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day of the eleventh month Commander-in-Chief Xiao Dili and others encamped east of Qinlin Marsh and were again struck by Jurchen; very many soldiers died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，蕭敵里亦坐免官。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Xiao Dili also was dismissed from office for the offense.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Xiao Dili also was dismissed from office for the offense.

sentences.zh: 」一二：辛丑，以西北路招討使耶律斡里朵為行軍都統，」一三：副點檢蕭乙薛、同知南院樞密使事耶律章奴副之。

translations.literal: — [12]: On xinchou day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo was made field army commander-in-chief; — [13]: deputy inspector Xiao Yixue and associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhangnu were deputies.
translations.idiomatic: — [12]: On xinchou day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo was made field army commander-in-chief; — [13]: deputy inspector Xiao Yixue and associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhangnu were deputies.

sentences.zh: 十二月，咸、賓、祥三州及鐵驪、兀惹皆叛入女直。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, Xian, Bin, Xiang, and the three prefectures and Iron Li and Wunai all rebelled and entered Jurchen.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xian, Bin, Xiang, and the three prefectures and Iron Li and Wunai all rebelled and entered Jurchen.

sentences.zh: 乙薛往援賓州，南軍諸將實婁、特烈等往援咸州，並為女直所敗。

translations.literal: Yixue went to relieve Bin Prefecture; southern army generals Shilou, Telie, and others went to relieve Xian Prefecture; all were defeated by Jurchen.
translations.idiomatic: Yixue went to relieve Bin Prefecture; southern army generals Shilou, Telie, and others went to relieve Xian Prefecture; all were defeated by Jurchen.

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation Notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation Notes

sentences.zh: 一：辛亥葬仁聖大孝文皇帝宣懿皇后于慶陵遼文匯八道宗哀冊、宣懿哀冊並作壬子將遷座於永福陵。

translations.literal: 1: On xinhai day buried the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi at Qing Mausoleum — Liao texts collected in eight fascicles, Daozong's mourning proclamation and Xuanyi's mourning proclamation both read renyin and moving the seat to Yongfu Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: 1: On xinhai day buried the Benevolent Sage Great Filial Literary Emperor and Empress Xuanyi at Qing Mausoleum — Liao texts collected in eight fascicles, Daozong's mourning proclamation and Xuanyi's mourning proclamation both read renyin and moving the seat to Yongfu Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 二：其弟阿骨打襲按金史世紀，楊割

translations.literal: 2: His younger brother Aguda succeeded — According to the Basic Annals of the Jin History, Yangge
translations.idiomatic: 2: His younger brother Aguda succeeded — According to the Basic Annals of the Jin History, Yangge

sentences.zh: （盈歌）〉

translations.literal: (Yingge)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Yingge)〉

sentences.zh: 卒於乾統三年癸未，烏雅束襲；

translations.literal: died in the third year of Qiantong, guiwei; Wugusun succeeded;
translations.idiomatic: died in the third year of Qiantong, guiwei; Wugusun succeeded;

sentences.zh: 烏雅束卒于天慶三年癸巳，阿骨打襲。

translations.literal: Wugusun died in the third year of Tianqing, guisi; Aguda succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Wugusun died in the third year of Tianqing, guisi; Aguda succeeded.

sentences.zh: 此系帶敘，年份未合。

translations.literal: This is mixed narrative; the years do not agree.
translations.idiomatic: This is mixed narrative; the years do not agree.

sentences.zh: 三：宋遣林洙來議與夏約和林洙，國志一○、宋史二 ○及長編並作林攄。

translations.literal: 3: Song dispatched Lin Zhu to discuss peace with Xia — Lin Zhu: National Records 10, Song History 20, and the Long Compilation all read Lin Shu.
translations.idiomatic: 3: Song dispatched Lin Zhu to discuss peace with Xia — Lin Zhu: National Records 10, Song History 20, and the Long Compilation all read Lin Shu.

sentences.zh: 四：知北院樞密使事蕭得里底事字原脫，據上文四年六月及卷一○○本傳補。

translations.literal: 4: Acting Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Delidi — the character shi was originally missing; supplied from the sixth month of the fourth year above and juan 100 of this work, his biography.
translations.idiomatic: 4: Acting Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Delidi — the character shi was originally missing; supplied from the sixth month of the fourth year above and juan 100 of this work, his biography.

sentences.zh: 五：遣劉正符曹穆來告劉正符，國志一○、宋史二 ○及長編並作劉正夫。

translations.literal: 5: Dispatched Liu Zhengfu and Cao Mu to announce — Liu Zhengfu: National Records 10, Song History 20, and the Long Compilation all read Liu Zhengfu.
translations.idiomatic: 5: Dispatched Liu Zhengfu and Cao Mu to announce — Liu Zhengfu: National Records 10, Song History 20, and the Long Compilation all read Liu Zhengfu.

sentences.zh: 六：以和魯斡為義和仁聖皇太叔按皇子表，聖作壽。

translations.literal: 6: Heluwo was titled Imperial Grand Uncle of Yihe, Benevolent and Sagely — According to the table of imperial sons, sage reads longevity.
translations.idiomatic: 6: Heluwo was titled Imperial Grand Uncle of Yihe, Benevolent and Sagely — According to the table of imperial sons, sage reads longevity.

sentences.zh: 和魯斡與天祚為祖孫輩，「皇太叔」系封號。

translations.literal: Heluwo and Tianzuo were separated by a grandfather's generation; "Imperial Grand Uncle" is a title of enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Heluwo and Tianzuo were separated by a grandfather's generation; "Imperial Grand Uncle" is a title of enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 七：封高麗王為三韓國公贈其父為高麗國王按高麗史一一，壽昌三年已封為高麗王，六年已封為三韓國公。

translations.literal: 7: Enfeoffed the Goryeo king as Duke of Three Han States and posthumously enfeoffed his father as King of Goryeo — According to Goryeo History 11, in the third year of Shouchang he had already been enfeoffed King of Goryeo; in the sixth year he had already been enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.
translations.idiomatic: 7: Enfeoffed the Goryeo king as Duke of Three Han States and posthumously enfeoffed his father as King of Goryeo — According to Goryeo History 11, in the third year of Shouchang he had already been enfeoffed King of Goryeo; in the sixth year he had already been enfeoffed Duke of Three Han States.

sentences.zh: 又卷一二，六年二月，遼遣使冊為高麗王，無追封之事。

translations.literal: Also juan 12: sixth year, second month, Liao dispatched envoys to invest him as King of Goryeo; there is no matter of posthumous enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Also juan 12: sixth year, second month, Liao dispatched envoys to invest him as King of Goryeo; there is no matter of posthumous enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 八：正月如鴨子河至二月幸混同江按紀太平四年二月，「詔改鴨子河曰混同江」。
